units.characteristics: the incurable wound healed by God; care for the un-cared-for outcast; measured discipline
units.gist: GEM - the day of distress 'yet HE SHALL BE SAVED out of it'; 'FEAR NOT, O Jacob... I am with you to save you; I will discipline you IN JUST MEASURE'; 'your hurt is INCURABLE... no healing for you'; YET 'I will RESTORE HEALTH to you, and your wounds I WILL HEAL, because they called you an OUTCAST: Zion, for whom NO ONE CARES' - the humanly-incurable wound healed by God precisely because no one else cares

units.characteristics: everlasting love; the father-heart that yearns; mourning turned to joy; the weary soul satisfied
units.gist: THE GEM - 'I have LOVED YOU WITH AN EVERLASTING LOVE; therefore I have continued my faithfulness'; 'I am a FATHER to Israel'; 'I will turn their MOURNING INTO JOY... gladness for sorrow'; Rachel weeping, refusing comfort, answered 'there is HOPE for your future'; Ephraim's repentance 'BRING ME BACK that I may be restored'; God's yearning 'Is Ephraim my dear son? my HEART YEARNS for him; I will surely have MERCY'; 'I will SATISFY the weary soul'

units.characteristics: the law written on the heart; all shall know God; sins remembered no more
units.gist: THE PEAK GEM - individual responsibility ('everyone shall die for his own iniquity'); 'I will make a NEW COVENANT... not like the old that they broke: I will PUT MY LAW WITHIN THEM, and WRITE IT ON THEIR HEARTS. And I will be their God, and they shall be my people. They shall ALL KNOW ME, from the least to the greatest, for I will FORGIVE their iniquity and REMEMBER THEIR SIN NO MORE' - the law internalised, the knowledge of God universal, sin forgiven and un-remembered

units.characteristics: hope enacted against all appearances; nothing too hard for God; one heart, the fear of God put within
units.gist: GEM - imprisoned during the siege, Jeremiah BUYS A FIELD (an act of hope in God's promise against all visible evidence); his prayer 'Ah, Lord GOD... NOTHING IS TOO HARD FOR YOU'; God's echo 'is anything too hard for me?'; 'I will give them ONE HEART AND ONE WAY, that they may fear me forever... I will PUT THE FEAR OF ME IN THEIR HEARTS, that they may NOT TURN from me. I will REJOICE in doing them good... with ALL MY HEART AND ALL MY SOUL'

units.characteristics: call to me and I will answer; cleansing and forgiveness; the covenant as fixed as day and night
units.gist: GEM - 'CALL TO ME AND I WILL ANSWER YOU, and will tell you great and HIDDEN THINGS that you have not known'; 'I will bring HEALTH and HEALING... I will CLEANSE them from all the guilt of their sin, and FORGIVE'; 'the LORD is GOOD, his STEADFAST LOVE endures forever'; the Branch 'the LORD is our righteousness'; the covenant as unbreakable as 'my covenant with day and night' - the invitation to call, the cleansing, the immovable faithfulness
